name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.

versions.changelog: Fixes an enabled Display Logos Only Top Row disappearing by matching Collection Manager's dashed collection GUIDs with Jellyfin Web's undashed item IDs, while preserving exact source logos, smaller geometry, normal scrolling, header positioning, and strict Media Bar separation.
